svg.title: Stromal cell
svg.desc: Irregular stellate stromal support cell with oval nucleus, long matrix-contacting processes, and extracellular fibers. Biological basis: Mesenchymal stromal cells extend processes through extracellular matrix and provide structural and paracrine niche support.
